title: Paul Hembree - Found (Mathematical) Objects: Generative Beats Without AI/ML
speaker: Paul Hembree
talk_title: Found (Mathematical) Objects: Generative Beats Without AI/ML
description: We're going to gather disparate threads from Euclid, particle accelerator timing, Marcel Duchamp, music cognition, and minimalism, all in order to build a 100% ethical beat generator.
